zh.title: 英航波音777-200ER將由空中巴士A350-1000與波音787-10飛機接手
zh.summary: 英國航空43架平均機齡約26年的波音777-200ER，將由空中巴士A350-1000與波音787-10接手希斯洛航線，波音777-9隨後加入；不過英航尚未公布希斯洛退役時程，目前僅納許維爾航線的替換已確認。
body: 英國航空現有43架波音777-200ER，平均機齡約26年，多數飛航倫敦希斯洛（LHR）而非蓋威克，據報英航計畫全數退役，部分飛機退役時機齡將超過30年。接手希斯洛航線的機型為空中巴士A350-1000（已開始接手部分航線）與波音787-10，其後還有長期延遲的波音777-9。不過英航尚未公布希斯洛777-200ER退役日期，也未公布逐航線替換計畫，除納許維爾外，其餘替換皆為可能性，而非已確認計畫。

唯一已確認的替換是納許維爾：英航已排定A350-1000自3月29日起取代每日希斯洛—納許維爾航線的777-200ER，航班時間不變，去程BA223為9小時10分鐘，回程BA222為8小時10分鐘。該航線A350-1000載客331席，較777-200ER的272席增加59席，且未增加航班，貨艙也明顯較大；A350-1000尺寸與波音777-300ER相當。787-10唯一明確日期屬於蓋威克，執行長Sean Doyle在2026年2月27日給同事的訊息中表示，首架新飛機將於2029年交付至蓋威克；蓋威克新機預計不設頭等艙，新訂購的787-10將採用通用電氣GEnx發動機，為夢幻客機機隊在勞斯萊斯之外引進第二家發動機供應商。

訂單方面，英航在2025年3月增加6架後共有24架波音777-9訂單，另有6架A350-1000與38架787-10訂單，其中包括2025年宣布的32架；777-9目前尚無任何一架加入機隊。777-9在2026年年中仍處於認證程序尾聲，波音預計2027年交付首架，屆時空中巴士可能已有逾150架A350-1000投入營運。多數替換仍需數年，舊機持續高強度飛行：BA229飛往巴爾的摩的航班於2026年7月9日返回希斯洛，BA183飛往紐約的航班於次日晚間折返，兩班均由777-200ER執飛，機組發現技術問題，兩班航班其後均取消。

en.title: The aircraft set to replace British Airways' Boeing 777-200ERs at London Heathrow (LHR)
en.summary: British Airways' 43 Boeing 777-200ERs, averaging about 26 years old, are set to be replaced at Heathrow by Airbus A350-1000s and Boeing 787-10s, with Boeing 777-9s to follow — but the airline has announced no Heathrow retirement date, and only the Nashville switch is confirmed.
body: British Airways operates 43 Boeing 777-200ERs with an average age of about 26 years, most of them flying from London Heathrow (LHR) rather than Gatwick, and the airline is reported to plan retiring all of them, with some more than 30 years old by the time they leave. The aircraft set to take over at Heathrow are the Airbus A350-1000, which has already begun picking up routes, and the Boeing 787-10, followed by the long-delayed Boeing 777-9. But British Airways has announced neither a retirement date for the Heathrow 777-200ERs nor a route-by-route replacement plan, so beyond Nashville the switches remain possibilities rather than confirmed plans.

The one confirmed switch is Nashville: British Airways has scheduled the A350-1000 to replace the daily Heathrow–Nashville 777-200ER from March 29, with flight times unchanged — BA223 at 9 hours 10 minutes and BA222 at 8 hours 10 minutes. On that route the A350-1000 carries 331 seats against the 777-200ER's 272, an increase of 59 seats without adding a flight, with a larger cargo hold as well; the A350-1000 is similar in size to the Boeing 777-300ER. The only firm date for the 787-10 is at Gatwick, where chief executive Sean Doyle said in a February 27, 2026 message to colleagues that the first new aircraft will arrive in 2029; Gatwick's new jets are expected to have no First cabin, and the new 787-10s will use General Electric GEnx engines, a second engine supplier for the Dreamliner fleet alongside Rolls-Royce.

On orders, British Airways holds 24 Boeing 777-9s after adding six in March 2025, plus six additional A350-1000s and 38 Boeing 787-10s, including 32 announced in 2025; none of the 777-9s has joined the fleet. The 777-9 was still in the final stages of certification in mid-2026, and Boeing expects to deliver the first aircraft in 2027, by which time Airbus may have well over 150 A350-1000s in service. With most replacements still years away, the older jets keep flying at high intensity: BA229 to Baltimore returned to Heathrow on July 9, 2026 and BA183 to New York turned back the following evening, both 777-200ERs with technical issues found and both flights cancelled.

British Airways holds orders for 24 Boeing 777-9s, six additional A350-1000s and 38 Boeing 787-10s, including 32 announced in 2025; no 777-9 has joined the fleet.
Boeing expects to deliver the first 777-9 in 2027, after the aircraft was still in the final stages of certification in mid-2026.
